design_type: Separately preregistered, one-shot transport-timeout recovery after R2's first bounded Wayback CDX request timed out after 25 seconds with zero response bytes; no archive row outcome is inferred.

archive_capture.selection_rationale: This was the previously observed 097 contract full archive under the 20 MB cap that intersects the pre-existing FY2025 frozen sample. Selection is by archive identity and size, before inspecting archive rows.

historical_inventory_context.cdx_discovery_query: Wayback CDX prefix inventory of 097 contract archive URLs; earlier discovery used URL-key collapse.
historical_inventory_context.limitation: URL-coverage metadata only, not a complete historical capture timeline.

frozen_row_selection.selection_rule: Derive all target keys from the exact pinned manifest at runtime; no post-inspection additions/removals/ranking. Composite keys must be unique; if an agency-code column exists, a matched row must show code 097.

interpretation_contract.present_in_archive_snapshot: Present in this exact archive at the pinned Wayback capture timestamp, a known-available-by-snapshot bound only, not first-public time.
interpretation_contract.not_found_in_snapshot: Not found in this exact snapshot only; not proof of historical absence from other public channels.
interpretation_contract.filename_date: A filename date is not first-public timestamp.
interpretation_contract.action_or_issued_date: Action Date and Issued Date are not first-public-observation timestamps.

recovery.reason: R2 made one CDX request with zero response bytes and recorded TimeoutError at the frozen 25-second timeout. R3 uses a distinct preregistration and marker and changes only the per-request timeout to 60 seconds; the source, selected keys, request-count ceiling, byte/ZIP/CSV caps, interpretation, and scientific gates remain unchanged.
